case.question: Did testosterone actually increase major cardiovascular events, and what risks matter more to men using TRT for aesthetics?

positioning.positioned_premise: The feared major-cardiovascular-event signal for testosterone was not seen in TRAVERSE, while endocrine suppression, fertility, blood pressure and other safety signals remain important.

segments.text: For years, testosterone had this reputation that if you took enough of it, eventually it would introduce itself on your EKG. Then Lincoff, Bhasin, Nissen and the TRAVERSE investigators actually ran the big cardiovascular-safety trial in more than five thousand men.

monologue_moves.text: For years, testosterone had this reputation that if you took enough of it, eventually it would introduce itself on your EKG.
Then Lincoff, Bhasin, Nissen and the TRAVERSE investigators actually ran the big cardiovascular-safety trial in more than five thousand men.

segments.production_note: Opening AI visual: neon EKG trace morphs cleanly into a capital T, then returns to a normal heartbeat. Follow with a fast, high-energy bodybuilding-stage cutaway: several exaggerated but non-identifiable Mr. Universe-style competitors posing under stage lights. No office activity, no papers on desks.

segments.text: Major cardiac events were 7.0 percent on testosterone and 7.3 percent on placebo. Testosterone was non-inferior. And for viewers who wisely forgot clinical-trial statistics, non-inferior does not mean better. It means the trial could rule out an unacceptable increase beyond its prespecified margin.

segments.text: So all those suspiciously jacked Hollywood guys can breathe a slightly heavier sigh of relief. In 2025 the FDA removed cardiovascular-risk language from testosterone boxed warnings, while adding blood-pressure warnings. But the adverse effect the aesthetic crowd may find more personal is simple: your testicles can get smaller.

segments.production_note: Receipt should be rendered as sourced typography, not fake document footage. Comic metaphor: one bright beach ball deflates rapidly toward tennis-ball size beside an unchanged six-pack silhouette. Keep it playful, non-graphic, immediately legible, and under two seconds.

segments.text: Exogenous testosterone tells the pituitary that production has been outsourced. LH, luteinizing hormone, and FSH, follicle-stimulating hormone, fall. So can endogenous testosterone and sperm production. So the consumer question becomes: would you trade some volume downstairs for visible abs? Personally, I am open to negotiations.

segments.text: Repros Therapeutics tried another route with enclomiphene: stimulate LH and FSH and keep the testes making testosterone themselves. They reached Phase 3 and still could not get the ball across the finish line. Meanwhile TESTOPEL uses actual implanted testosterone pellets. Testosterone apparently comes in every format except subtle.
